name: Parallax Strip Transition
description: Full-bleed image scenes with directional strip reveals, a soft parallax zoom, and a smoothly rolling numeric counter.
summary: An image-only Virat Kohli collection using the supplied strip-reveal mechanism. One GSAP timeline coordinates image masks, zoom, and directional number changes. Tune the motion in Component Studio.
highlights: Image-only scenes with no headings, captions, or progress bar
Directional strip reveals reverse when moving backwards
Pixel-aligned full-bleed imagery with adjustable crops
Smooth rolling numbers share the image transition timeline
Arrow buttons, arrow keys, Home/End, and horizontal touch gestures
Optional autoplay pauses on hover, focus, hidden tabs, and offscreen content
Instant changes for system or explicit reduced-motion preferences
Scoped GSAP cleanup with guarded rapid navigation
anatomy: Temporary incoming strips with shared image geometry
Masked rolling current number and static total
Icon-only arrow controls and optional autoplay pause

physics.description: A single scoped timeline reveals directional strip masks while easing every image fragment from the same scale to 1. The current number rolls out as the incoming number rolls in, using synchronized power3 easing. Incoming scenes wait for their image to load; adjacent images are preloaded.

keyboard.description: Focus the collection and its icon controls.
Navigate to the previous or next scene.
Navigate to the first or last scene.
Activate the focused arrow or autoplay control.

accessibility.aria: Descriptive image alt text, icon buttons with accessible names, busy state, and screen-reader-only completed-scene announcements. Decorative strips and rolling numbers are hidden from assistive technology.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Skips image zoom, strip wipes, and number rolling. Automatic playback is disabled when reduced motion is requested.

recommended: Editorial landing pages and visual collections
bestPractices: Supply unique slide ids and descriptive image alt text. An optional title is used only for accessible announcements.
Use landscape images and imagePosition to preserve important subjects.
Give the component a defined height when embedding it in a panel.
Scene navigation is local to the component; it does not intercept browser routes or history.
Keep autoplay optional and retain visible pause and navigation controls.

props.name: slides
props.description: Images with unique id, src, alt, optional imagePosition, and optional title for screen-reader announcements.

props.name: stripCount
props.description: Number of aligned vertical image strips, clamped to 2–20.

props.name: duration
props.description: Image zoom and rolling-number duration in seconds, clamped to 0.35–2.

props.name: stripStagger
props.description: Delay between strip reveals in seconds, clamped to 0–0.08.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Automatically navigate when visible. Pauses on hover, focus, hidden tabs, and reduced motion.

props.name: autoplayInterval
props.description: Idle time between completed transitions in milliseconds, clamped to 3000–30000.

props.name: showControls
props.description: Show the rolling numeric counter, icon arrows, and optional autoplay controls. Also enables keyboard and touch navigation.

props.name: reduceMotion
props.description: Force instant scene changes. The system reduced-motion preference is always respected.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the default 600px frame. Use an explicit height inside containers.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the carousel region.
